anchor: A daily habit that always stays on your list, no matter what else is going on — like prayer, journaling, or family time. Anchors don't get buried by busy days; they're the non-negotiables.
venture: Any business, project, or personal track you're running — your startup, your side business, or just "Personal." You name your own ventures, and each one gets its own goals and tasks.
goal: Something you're working toward this year — broken into a few milestones that tell you whether you're actually making progress, not just staying busy.
milestone: A measurable marker of progress toward a goal — how you'll know it's actually moving, not just something you're hoping happens.
priority: The handful of things that matter most for a venture this quarter — if these get done in the next 90 days, that venture moves forward in a real way.
routine: A recurring task tied to one of your goals — like a workout, a check-in call, or a reading habit. Routines can be active, paused, or just planned for later.
task_board: Your board with four columns — To Do, In Progress, Done, and Blocked — so you can see at a glance what's moving and what's stuck.
brain_dump: A quick place to capture a thought the moment it hits you, before it's structured into a task or a plan. Say it or type it now, sort it out later.
plan_my_week: Looks at your active goals and priorities, then suggests a set of daily and weekly tasks to help you make progress — you review and edit everything before anything gets added to your board.
mail_briefing: A short digest of your important emails, so you don't have to sit in your inbox to know what actually needs your attention.
relationships: A place to track real progress on relationships that matter to your ventures — investors, partners, mentors — based on genuine actions, not just how many emails you sent.
anchor_chain: A visual streak of your anchors — it fills in as you complete each one, so you can see your consistency at a glance.
weekly_scorecard: A quick snapshot of your key numbers for the week, so you don't have to go digging for them.
key_numbers: The handful of numbers that actually tell you how a venture is doing, pulled up front so you don't have to hunt for them.
